name: facebookresearch_co-tracker/cotracker/evaluation/core/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_co-tracker/cotracker/ev.compute_tapvid_metrics: compute TAP-Vid metrics including Jaccard, points within threshold, and occlusion accuracy for video tracking predictions
facebookresearch_co-tracker/cotracker/ev.run_compute_tapvid_metrics: run compute_tapvid_metrics with query points, ground truth occlusions, and predicted tracks to evaluate tracking performance

facebookresearch_co-tracker/cotracker/ev.review_compute_tapvid_metrics: review compute_tapvid_metrics to understand how Jaccard and occlusion accuracy are computed across pixel thresholds
facebookresearch_co-tracker/cotracker/ev.refactor_compute_tapvid_metrics: refactor compute_tapvid_metrics to support additional query modes beyond first and strided sampling strategies

facebookresearch_co-tracker/cotracker/ev.run_Evaluator_compute_metrics: run the Evaluator compute_metrics method to compute tracking accuracy metrics for tapvid or dynamic_replica datasets
facebookresearch_co-tracker/cotracker/ev.create_Evaluator_instance: create an Evaluator instance with an experiment directory path for CoTracker model evaluation and visualization
facebookresearch_co-tracker/cotracker/ev.test_Evaluator_tapvid_evaluation: test the Evaluator evaluate_sequence method with a tapvid dataset to compute query-based tracking metrics
facebookresearch_co-tracker/cotracker/ev.test_Evaluator_online_model: test the Evaluator evaluate_sequence method with a CoTrackerThreeOnline model for online tracking evaluation
